# The Woodcutters' Hut

*Past the Bluecap Groves stands the old woodcutters' hut in Breezy Hollow, and Molly thinks Mott could have taken shelter there. Reach the hut, defeat 50 Paleveil Caps around it so whoever is inside can walk out, then talk to Mott.*

## Objectives

1. Reach the old woodcutters' hut in [Breezy Hollow](../maps/breezy_hollow.md)
2. Defeat 50 [Paleveil Cap](../monsters/paleveil_cap.md)
3. Talk to [Mott](../npcs/mott.md)

## Rewards

- 48,000 EXP
- 8,000 mesos
- [Elixir](../items/elixir.md) x3
- +60 standing with Kaldemor
